settings.detail_1:
We offer free shipping on all orders to the contiguous 48 states in the United States.

  • Processing time: 1–3 business days
  • Shipping time: usually 2–5 business days (depending on your location)
  • Carriers: UPS / FedEx

Note:
We currently do not ship to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, PO Boxes, or APO/FPO addresses.
You will receive a tracking number once your order ships. More
settings.detail_2:
We offer a 30-day free return policy.

  • You may return the bike within 30 days of delivery if it is in new, unused condition with original packaging.
  • To start a return, please email us at support@aotos.com with your order number and photos/videos if needed.
  • We will review your request within 3 business days.

Return shipping:

  • If the return is due to our error (wrong item, quality issue, etc.), we cover the return shipping cost.
  • If the return is due to change of mind, the customer is responsible for return shipping.
  • No restocking fee will be charged.

More
settings.detail_3:
Your Flux X26 Series is covered by our limited warranty:

  • Main Components (Frame, Fork, Handlebar, Motor, Battery, Controller, Display, etc.): 1 Year
  • Main Accessories (Throttle, Lights, Brake Levers, Charger, Shock Absorber, etc.): 6 Months
  • Wear & Tear Parts (Tires, Fenders, Seat, Foot Pegs, Plastic Parts, etc.): 3 Months

Battery Note:
Covered for 1 year or 500 charge cycles (whichever comes first), with capacity remaining at least 80% of rated capacity under normal conditions.

Warranty does not cover damage caused by improper use, accidents, or unauthorized modifications.More
settings.detail_4:
We’re here to help!

  • Email: support@aotos.com
  • Hours: 10:00 AM–8:30 PM (HKT)

For the fastest response, please include your order number when contacting us.
Our team typically replies within 1 business day.
